description: This file defines an abstract test runner class for programmatic stream subscription tests in Orleans, along with a helper class for managing stream subscriptions. It includes test methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, and verifying stream subscriptions and message flow between producers and consumers, with specific focus on stream provider handling and subscription management.

classes.name: ProgrammaticSubscribeTestsRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing a suite of streaming subscription tests for Orleans, including subscribing, unsubscribing, and verifying message flow between grains.

classes.name: SubscriptionManager
classes.description: A helper class to manage stream subscriptions within tests, including setup, addition, retrieval, and removal of subscriptions.

methods.name: ProducerHasProducedSinceLastCheck
methods.description: Checks if the producer has produced more messages since the last check.

methods.name: CheckCounters
methods.description: Verifies that the number of produced messages matches the number of consumed messages for a set of producers and a consumer.
